description: a11ign/control's Renovate config (a11ign/a11ign#5223, part of #5153). OFF until the dry run is quoted on the row, then `enabled` is set true. Revert: `enabled: false`. A bump PR changes the VERSION ONLY: the MSI url and the checksums beside each pin are not machine-readable from the pinned version, so a person completes that PR, and `edge-pin-parity.test.ts` / `node-pin-parity.test.ts` keep it red until they do. It never deploys: a worker reaches a new pin only through a `fleet:deploy` the fleet's owner runs.

edge-stable.description: Microsoft's enterprise catalogue. Highest Stable x64 Windows ProductVersion, which is the rule worker_edge_version's own comment states: an older-branch patch published later is not a newer build.

customManagers.description: worker_edge_version: the Edge build every worker runs
worker_node_version: the Node build every worker runs (the `v` stays literal in the file)

packageRules.description: A pin here travels with a download url and checksums a version bump cannot fill in, so no bump merges itself.
